name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Midnight Berry
description:
Rocket Blast 1G Cart — Midnight Berry (510 Thread)

Dark, sweet, and smooth. The Rocket Blast Midnight Berry cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Midnight Berry brings a rich, fruit-forward flavor: ripe blackberry and dark berry notes up front with a sweet, jammy finish that stays smooth pull after pull. It's a deep, mellow profile made for easygoing sessions and late-night wind-downs.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Midnight Berry flavor — ripe blackberry and dark berry with a sweet, jammy finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Midnight Berry is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
